CLASS zcl_i105_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS run.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i105_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run.
    DATA lv TYPE i.
    lv = zcl_i105_leaf=>calc( ).
    CALL FUNCTION 'RFC_SYSTEM_INFO'.
    zcl_i105_b=>run( ).
    SUBMIT zi105_rep AND RETURN.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
